rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance: source of income as a protected category
rules.requirement: Under the Cambridge Human Rights Ordinance and Fair Housing Ordinance, source of income (including Section 8 and public benefits) is a protected category. Housing discrimination based on it is therefore barred. The passage does not describe specific screening procedures or timing rules.
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
rules.review_note: The source is an FAQ page that names the ordinances but gives no section numbers or dates. It does not set out the ordinance text, and it says nothing on criminal history, credit or eviction-record limits for Cambridge. The D010 policy passages (p3, p6) do not identify the jurisdiction, so they were not attributed to Cambridge.
